conversation.speaker: user_agent

conversation.speaker: ai_agent

conversation.message: That sounds fascinating! Could you explain what "superposition" and "entanglement" mean in this context?

conversation.speaker: ai_agent
conversation.message: Certainly! Superposition means a quantum bit, or qubit, can exist in multiple states simultaneously, unlike a classical bit which is either 0 or 1. Entanglement is when two or more qubits become linked, sharing the same fate even when physically separated.

conversation.speaker: user_agent
conversation.message: So, qubits can be both 0 and 1 at the same time, and entangled qubits are always in sync?

conversation.speaker: ai_agent

conversation.speaker: ai_agent

conversation.speaker: ai_agent
